name: codesight
description: CodeSight — Universal GraphRAG Plugin (MCP Apps) & Apple Floating HUD for Vibe Coding

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/core && npm run build --workspace=@codesight/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/cli && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/sidecar && npm run build --workspace=@glassbox/hud
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codesight/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/sidecar && npm run typecheck --workspace=@glassbox/hud
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@glassbox/core && npm run test --workspace=@codesight/mcp-server
